records.deidentified_narrative: on december 19, 2019 at 1000, an adult female student (ped) stated she was struck by a vehicle on december 18th @ 1615. she states she was walking out of harlan hs, near main gym and was hit by a grey volkswagen as she transitioned from on sidewalk to another sidewalk between parking stalls. in speaking with the pedestrian, she recalled, looking both ways, verifying the traffic was clear and processed towards her vehicle. before she could reach the next sidewalk a grey volkswagen (tx lp mph 9784) struck her on the right hip. the impact/scare caused her to jump several feet away from the car. she did not fall, stumble or receive secondary injuries after the impact. she believes she was in shock and did not realize she had pain, to the touch, on her right hip until hours later. she states the driver of the vehicle continued to make a right turn after a short pause. no verbal communication was exchanged following the strike. the driver of the grey volkswagen, an adult male, confirmed her story. he believes he released his foot from the brake and ""rolled"" forward while not paying attention to the students walking in front of him. the drivers states he was looking on his phone and was temporarily distracted. the driver states she was struck by his passenger side front bumper. he believed the impact was so minimal, the female student was ""okay"" and did not need assistance. harlan hs surveillance (camera 025-028 at 1617) confirm the accident.

motor vehicle, causing unit 1 to collide front concentrated (front right area) to unit 2 pedestrian. unit 2 was projected forward in a northwest direction to the right shoulder, where he came to rest, laying face up. unit 2 pedestrian suffered fatal injuries during the crash. dfd rescue 57 responded to the scene and found unit 2 pedestrian to have no vital signs at 5:33 am on [date]. medical examiner representative b. andree responded to the scene to take possession of unit 2 pedestrian remains. medical examiners office [case id]. crime scene element [identifier] responded to the scene and took photographs. traffic sgt finley #7763 responded to the scene and created a forensic map of the crash scene. vcu detective shaw #8357 responded to the scene, interviewed unit 1 driver and took photographs. this report is incomplete pending toxicology results for unit 2 pedestrian. ********** on [date], i/o #8502 supplemented this report to include the blood results for unit 2 pedestrian. unit 2 pedestrian blood results showed to be positive for drugs. drugs - tetrahydrocannabinol: 2. 2 +/- 0. 4 ng/ml, amphetamine: 21. 3 +/- 1. 6 ng/ml, methamphetamine: 323. 5 +/- 24. 3 ng/ml, diphenhydramine: 0. 08 +/- 0. 01 mg/l and phencyclidine: < 0. 02 +/- 0. 00 mg/l. i/o added a contributing factor of 68 - under the influence of drug to this report for unit 2 pedestrian. this report is now complete. **********
